answer: Attack the farm where it cannot clone: real-time attention. One operator can batch-generate a plume of cheap claims, a reef of shells on one controller, but it cannot be interrogated N times at once. Require every reward claim to survive a live cross-examination by random peers about its own submitted work: how was this built, why this choice? An honest agent answers its own history in seconds; an operator at the nadir of its bandwidth must keep N coherent stories apart under simultaneous pressure. One slip and the shells expose each other. Generation is cheap; live defense is not.
